user.title: AirPrint
user.description: Enter the address of the machine running the AirPrint add-on. If it runs on this Home Assistant, keep 127.0.0.1.

driver.title: {name} needs a driver
driver.description:
No driver for **{name}** is available, so it cannot print yet.

Most printers are matched automatically; yours needs one from its manufacturer. Paste a link to the driver — a `.deb`, a `.ppd`, or the vendor's `.tar.gz`.

You can leave this empty and add it later: open the printer under Settings → Devices & services → AirPrint, choose **Edit printer** and paste the link into **Driver file URL**.

data_description.driver: A direct link to the driver file. Host it yourself if you can — vendor links break when they publish an update.

error.driver_https: Use an https:// link. The driver is installed with full rights, so it must not be downloaded over plain http.
error.driver_file: Link to the driver file itself: the link must end in .deb, .ppd, .ppd.gz, .tar.gz or .tgz.
